notes.title: 1.0 "Invite a Friend" update!
notes.content:
[h3]New feature: Invite a Friend[/h3]
- Invite a friend into your game and play Aloof together online!
- You and your friend can freely move around between any game mode, like:
- Co-op Campaign
- Player versus Player
- Offline Adventure (versus AI)

[h3]Other changes to: Player versus Player[/h3]
- Now has 23 levels!
- Levels are divided into easy, medium and hard
- Let the computer select a _random_ easy, medium, hard or just any level

notes.title: Clever and challenging puzzle-fighter Aloof is out now, we have a few keys to give away
notes.content:
Inspired in parts by the likes of Puyo Puyo Tetris, Aloof is a wonderfully designed puzzle-fighter with enough differences and a wonderful atmosphere that make it worth picking up.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/03/clever-and-challenging-puzzle-fighter-aloof-is-out-now-we-have-a-few-keys-to-give-away

notes.title: Aloof wil join Steam's Remote Play Together Event the moment of release!
notes.content:
At the moment of release, Aloof will be part of Steam's Remote Play Together Event. This event celebrates this very nice feature which is still pretty unknown.

Using Remote Play Together, one player owns and runs the game. Others can be invited to play the local multiplayer modes online! 

Play Aloof's co-op campaign with a friend online using Remote Play Together :D

notes.title: Puzzle-battler Aloof is launching on March 25 and it looks fab, do try the demo
notes.content:
A puzzle-battler? Think like Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo and Puyo Puyo Tetris but with a new and fresh spin and that's what you're going to get with Aloof on March 25.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/02/puzzle-battler-aloof-is-launching-on-march-25

notes.title: Testing AI by playing against itself (real time)
notes.content:
[h2]How does this work?[/h2]
Each match the AI is randomly generated from these parts:
- 4-ish different ways to obtain Islands
- 4 ways to do attacks (from small combo's up to combo's of 5)
- 5 different tactics for when to repair an Island
- And a random chance to do some other tactics (to surprise the opponent)

[h2]Can I play against this AI in the game?[/h2]
Yes, you play against a randomly generated AI when playing "Practice Online". This mode is the same as playing online but instead of an other player, you play against this random AI.

notes.title: Dev plays the demo and explains stuff
notes.content:
Aloof is a puzzle battler, like Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo and Puyo Puyo Tetris, but plays completely different. In the world of Aloof you summon and defend small islands all the while you build combos against your opponent.

Please also note that the game is not done.

For more information about the game and the Online Adventure mode go to
https://www.pressbuttonx.com

For news and updates you can find me on Twitter:
@pressbuttonx

And don't forget to wishlist :)
